{{Top|leg}}
The '''long call''' was produced by the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] species through the use of their [[throat pouch]]es. A subsonic long range call, it was originally thought to have been either a mating call or distress signal. It could also be employed as a short range attack, causing disorientation and nausea in other species.
